title: Steiner Human Evolution Concordance
description: Editorial study index to Steiner's Lemurian, Atlantean, and Post-Atlantean evolutionary narrative. These claims are attributed to Steiner, not empirical history.
method: Lemurian entries are analytical milestones rather than Steiner-defined named sub-stages; Atlantean labels reproduce early historical-Theosophical terminology only; future periods are prospective. Inherited influences continue rather than being automatically replaced.

stages.name: Early plastic / will-dominated humanity
stages.inheritedForces: Earlier solar-lunar formative forces; pre-existing physical, etheric, astral organization
stages.activeForces: Intense soul-will acting into still-plastic bodily matter
stages.inheritedAbilities: Dreamlike soul awareness; direct instinctive response to nature
stages.newAbilities: Elementary will-based bodily control and imaginative response to environment
stages.decreasing: Clear memory, abstract thought, stable bodily form
stages.newInfluences: No precisely dated new influence assigned to this thematic row
stages.beings: Higher guides and creative hierarchies (not yet stage-assigned)
stages.people: Soft/pliable bodies; instinctive, pre-conceptual behavior
stages.events: Early Lemurian conditions precede full bodily differentiation
stages.contribution: Creates conditions for individualized embodiment
stages.risk: Unstable environment and undeveloped self-direction
stages.note: A comparative thematic milestone. These Lemurian entries overlap and are not Steiner's formal seven named subdivisions.

stages.name: Moon separation and stabilization
stages.inheritedForces: Plastic human form and evolving etheric/physical structures
stages.activeForces: Reordered solar and lunar influences; bodily consolidation
stages.inheritedAbilities: Soul-driven bodily plasticity and instinctive adaptation
stages.newAbilities: More sustainable earthly incarnation; conditions for firmer bodily organization
stages.decreasing: Extreme earlier fluidity / undifferentiated form
stages.newInfluences: The Moon separates from the Earth in Steiner’s macro-narrative
stages.beings: Sun and Moon spiritual powers / higher guiding beings
stages.people: Human embodiment increasingly adapted to earthly density
stages.events: Separation of Moon (broad Lemurian turning point)
stages.contribution: Makes durable development of human form possible
stages.risk: Increasing density restricts direct soul-control of matter
stages.note: A comparative thematic milestone. These Lemurian entries overlap and are not Steiner's formal seven named subdivisions.

stages.name: Division of sexes; forces redirected inward
stages.inheritedForces: Earlier bisexual/undifferentiated reproductive organization; plastically formed bodies
stages.activeForces: Polarization of reproductive forces; part of formative force turns inward
stages.inheritedAbilities: Instinctive reproductive and bodily formative capacities
stages.newAbilities: Conditions for development of inner organs of cognition and future thinking
stages.increasing: Inner organ formation; desire for knowledge
stages.decreasing: Self-reproduction and unrestricted outward body formation
stages.newInfluences: New male/female physical differentiation (not a new spiritual entity)
stages.beings: Higher beings of Love; advanced spiritual guides
stages.people: Physical differentiation; Steiner links redirected reproductive force to thought-organs
stages.events: Progressive differentiation of male and female bodies
stages.contribution: Seeds bodily basis for eventual independent thinking
stages.risk: Self-centered desire and separation from surroundings
stages.note: A comparative thematic milestone. These Lemurian entries overlap and are not Steiner's formal seven named subdivisions.

stages.name: Human “I” and Luciferic involvement
stages.inheritedForces: Earlier divinely guided soul life and newly differentiated bodies
stages.activeForces: Individual desire, independent perception, self-assertion; Luciferic impulses work on astral nature
stages.inheritedAbilities: Dreamlike clairvoyance, will, instinct, immature cognitive organs
stages.newAbilities: Capacity to err and choose; independent quest for knowledge; early ego-direction
stages.decreasing: Unquestioning spiritual guidance / innocence
stages.newInfluences: Luciferic/light-bringer beings act alongside guiding beings (not replacing them)
stages.beings: Luciferic beings; higher Beings of Love; human guides
stages.people: Steiner’s account of the Fall and the human soul’s more individual incarnation
stages.events: Luciferic intervention and deepening entry into sensory life
stages.contribution: Necessary precondition (with risks) for freedom and independence
stages.risk: Error, selfishness, premature sensory involvement
stages.note: A comparative thematic milestone. These Lemurian entries overlap and are not Steiner's formal seven named subdivisions.

stages.name: Will-training, nature magic and initiation
stages.inheritedForces: Strong will and immediate perception of growth/natural forces
stages.activeForces: Initiate-guided education in will, imaginative conception and natural-force work
stages.inheritedAbilities: Power to shape body by will; immediate reading of natural action
stages.newAbilities: Controlled feats of will; building in caves; schooling in forces of nature
stages.decreasing: Dependence on direct bodily plasticity as Earth hardens
stages.newInfluences: Organized initiatory guidance becomes socially formative (no unique date)
stages.beings: Initiates and spiritual world-powers in places of worship
stages.people: Special training sites, severe trials, authority of initiates
stages.events: Will-oriented “schools” and sanctuaries
stages.contribution: Transmits systematic cultivation of capacities later carried into Atlantis
stages.risk: Power without inner discipline; harsh training methods described by Steiner
stages.note: A comparative thematic milestone. These Lemurian entries overlap and are not Steiner's formal seven named subdivisions.

stages.name: Imagination, memory germs and moral feeling
stages.inheritedForces: Will culture; sense of forces in nature; songlike expression
stages.activeForces: Imaginative soul life and early enduring inner pictures
stages.inheritedAbilities: Instinctive imaginative perception and nature-consonant feeling
stages.newAbilities: Germs of memory, rudimentary moral contrasts, personal inwardness
stages.decreasing: Instant forgetting of every experience (begins to change)
stages.newInfluences: Priestess/wise-woman guidance emphasized in GA 11
stages.beings: Priestesses; higher leaders; guiding spiritual beings
stages.people: Steiner attributes distinctive soul-imaginative development to women in his narrative
stages.events: Emergence of good/evil contrasts and first retained inner pictures
stages.contribution: Provides foundations for Atlantean memory and social life
stages.risk: No reliable quantitative rate or universal gender rule established
stages.note: A comparative thematic milestone. These Lemurian entries overlap and are not Steiner's formal seven named subdivisions.

stages.name: Late priestess culture, selected colony, catastrophe
stages.inheritedForces: Formative will; early memory and imagination; hierarchical guidance
stages.activeForces: Rhythmic song and cultic organization; adaptation for future Atlantean life
stages.inheritedAbilities: Nature-working and germinal memory; elementary community culture
stages.newAbilities: Proto-language/rhythmic song; more durable training, cultivation and transmission
stages.increasing: Memory and culture transmission; selective settlement
stages.decreasing: Earlier total bodily flexibility; independent Lemurian homeland
stages.newInfluences: Higher leaders select a group for next epoch; no specific new class of beings established
stages.beings: Advanced guiding beings and priestesses
stages.people: Priestess-led chant, ritual rhythm; selected future-bearing community
stages.events: Volcanic fire catastrophes; preserved community prepared for Atlantis
stages.contribution: Hands forward formative skills and first memory to Atlantean development
stages.risk: Fire-related collapse, misuse of will in some accounts
stages.note: A comparative thematic milestone. These Lemurian entries overlap and are not Steiner's formal seven named subdivisions.

stages.name: Rmoahals
stages.inheritedForces: Lemurian will, nature-bond, first memory germs
stages.activeForces: Memory of sensory images; speech as nature-effective force
stages.inheritedAbilities: Instinctive knowledge of nature and will-power
stages.newAbilities: Naming, recollecting, magical/healing speech, human bonds through words
stages.decreasing: Immediate non-verbal nature-contact slowly starts receding
stages.newInfluences: Atlantean memory and effective naming emerge; no exclusive new being assigned
stages.beings: Nature-spirits; broader Atlantean hierarchies
stages.people: Sacred regard for speech; little appetite for using it selfishly
stages.events: First Atlantean memory-speech culture
stages.contribution: Begins humanity’s memory epoch
stages.risk: Magic of words declines in later stages
stages.note: An early GA 11 historical-Theosophical stage label; not an ethnic category or a claim about contemporary peoples.

stages.name: Tlavatlis
stages.inheritedForces: Rmoahal memory and speech; natural life-force awareness
stages.activeForces: Personal memory of deeds, ambition and community self-consciousness
stages.inheritedAbilities: Ability to recall and speak with force
stages.newAbilities: Recognizing achievement; choosing leaders; veneration of ancestors
stages.decreasing: Non-personal innocent regard for shared powers
stages.newInfluences: Personal ambition and self-importance become prominent (not newly arriving beings)
stages.beings: Luciferic desire continues; guiding powers not mapped stagewise
stages.people: Leaders recognized for remembered achievements
stages.events: Elective leadership, ancestor reverence
stages.contribution: Memory begins to organize social groups
stages.risk: Vanity and emerging power-seeking
stages.note: An early GA 11 historical-Theosophical stage label; not an ethnic category or a claim about contemporary peoples.

stages.name: Toltecs
stages.inheritedForces: Shared memory; leaders; verbal and life-force power
stages.activeForces: Memory-based commonwealths, heredity of offices and king-initiations
stages.inheritedAbilities: Communal history; instinctive powers; social cohesion
stages.newAbilities: Organized states, dynastic rule, stronger teacher-pupil transfer
stages.decreasing: Purely spontaneous kinship as only social organizing basis
stages.newInfluences: Initiated ruler institutions; this is an institutional—not new cosmic—impulse
stages.beings: King-initiates; Atlantean oracle wisdom
stages.people: Ruler-initiates; vividly remembered ancestry
stages.events: Early statecraft; influence of hereditary kings and initiation
stages.contribution: Transforms personal memory into structured social civilization
stages.risk: Power concentration and selfish use of life forces
stages.note: An early GA 11 historical-Theosophical stage label; not an ethnic category or a claim about contemporary peoples.

stages.name: Original Turanians
stages.inheritedForces: Life-force mastery, memory-based polities, personal ambition
stages.activeForces: Self-serving manipulation of growth/reproduction forces
stages.inheritedAbilities: Ability to work living forces directly
stages.newAbilities: Strong practical command, but directed toward subjective appetite
stages.increasing: Unrestrained desire and exploitation of life forces
stages.decreasing: Harmony and reverence toward living forces
stages.newInfluences: Ahrimanic entry is placed around MIDDLE of Atlantis broadly; NOT securely tied to this exact sub-stage
stages.beings: Luciferic influences persist; Ahriman around middle (epoch-wide)
stages.people: Desire-driven power; harmful uses of initiated knowledge
stages.events: Widespread misuse of formative forces in GA 11
stages.contribution: Shows why unregulated will must be restrained by judgment
stages.risk: Conflicting forces and, in wider Atlantis, climatic and flood catastrophes
stages.note: An early GA 11 historical-Theosophical stage label; not an ethnic category or a claim about contemporary peoples.

stages.name: Original Semites
stages.inheritedForces: Power of memory; spiritual initiation; consequences of life-force misuse
stages.activeForces: Reflective judgment and comparison of experiences
stages.inheritedAbilities: Picture-memory and social traditions
stages.newAbilities: Calculation, reasoning, inner deliberation, control of wants
stages.decreasing: Direct command over germinal life forces
stages.newInfluences: No separate new hostile being specified; Ahrimanic influence continues
stages.beings: Sun/Christ oracle guidance, Luciferic/Ahrimanic background
stages.people: Person begins consulting an inner voice before acting
stages.events: Selection of future-bearing intellectually capable population
stages.contribution: Crucial shift from nature-magical power to thinking freedom
stages.risk: Earlier powers fade; inherited desires remain
stages.note: An early GA 11 historical-Theosophical stage label; not an ethnic category or a claim about contemporary peoples.

stages.name: Akkadians
stages.inheritedForces: Original-Semitic reflective thinking, memory and social organization
stages.activeForces: Practical calculation, law, innovation, trade
stages.inheritedAbilities: Judgment, concern for practical rules
stages.newAbilities: Legislation, commerce, deliberate settlement and enterprise
stages.decreasing: Former immediate germinal-force mastery
stages.newInfluences: No new spiritual order mapped exclusively to this stage
stages.beings: Same continuing opposing and guiding currents
stages.people: Prudent, change-seeking, commercially active
stages.events: Lawmaking and commercial expansion
stages.contribution: Creates legal frameworks for independent people
stages.risk: Restlessness; rational cunning can serve self-interest
stages.note: An early GA 11 historical-Theosophical stage label; not an ethnic category or a claim about contemporary peoples.

stages.name: Mongolian
stages.inheritedForces: Thought, memory, ancestral tradition, diminished life-force magic
stages.activeForces: Thinking retained together with devotion to ancient power
stages.inheritedAbilities: Sense of inherited tradition and newer reflection
stages.newAbilities: Combination of thought with belief in ancient force
stages.increasing: Thought and continuity of inherited tradition
stages.decreasing: Literal direct command over life-forces
stages.newInfluences: No uniquely new being identified by Steiner for this substage
stages.beings: Continuing oracle and spiritual currents; stage-specific assignment absent
stages.people: Veneration of what is ancient; intense belief in residual life-force
stages.events: Late Atlantean persistence while broader epoch ends in floods
stages.contribution: Preserves an older strand alongside emerging reason
stages.risk: Danger of clinging to inherited belief; epoch-wide final upheavals
stages.note: An early GA 11 historical-Theosophical stage label; not an ethnic category or a claim about contemporary peoples.

stages.name: Ancient Indian
stages.inheritedForces: Last Atlantean memory, spiritual longings, beginnings of thought
stages.activeForces: Etheric organization receives special emphasis; supersensible remembrance
stages.inheritedAbilities: Reflective thinking seed and traces of spiritual awareness
stages.newAbilities: Sacred spiritual teaching articulated by seven Rishis; cosmological wisdom
stages.decreasing: Earlier direct Atlantean clairvoyance as everyday endowment
stages.newInfluences: Manu’s cultural impulse and seven Rishis; not the first arrival of Christ
stages.beings: Manu; seven Rishis; spiritual teachers; Christ oracle background
stages.people: Physical appearance regarded as maya; spiritual homeland revered
stages.events: Ancient Indian foundation from Manu-linked teaching
stages.contribution: Transfers oracle wisdom into human culture
stages.risk: Diminished attraction to practical sensory-world mastery
stages.note: A post-Atlantean cultural period in Steiner's account.

stages.name: Ancient Persian
stages.inheritedForces: Ancient Indian spiritual inheritance; growing thought and earthly embodiment
stages.activeForces: Sentient/astral body emphasized; active relation to earthly work
stages.inheritedAbilities: Spiritual wisdom, reasoning beginnings
stages.newAbilities: Working the Earth and consciously meeting cosmic light/darkness opposition
stages.increasing: Conscious engagement with Earth; constructive will
stages.decreasing: Exclusive treatment of world as merely illusion
stages.newInfluences: Zarathustra’s Ahura Mazda teaching highlights opposition of Ahriman
stages.beings: Zarathustra; Ahura Mazda/Ormuzd; Ahriman
stages.people: Struggle between light and darkness, earth cultivation
stages.events: Zarathustra spiritual mission
stages.contribution: Spiritual will increasingly works through earthly activity
stages.risk: Ahrimanic temptation and dualistic fixation
stages.note: A post-Atlantean cultural period in Steiner's account.

stages.name: Egyptian–Chaldean
stages.inheritedForces: Persian earthly engagement, sacred wisdom and cosmic orientation
stages.activeForces: Sentient soul increasingly central; connection between stars and earthly life
stages.inheritedAbilities: Spiritual tradition, ritual, developing earthly knowledge
stages.newAbilities: Celestial observation, mystery symbolism, practical cosmic/earth relations
stages.increasing: Sentient-soul differentiation, ordered study of nature and stars
stages.decreasing: Immediate spiritual dependence characteristic of earlier age
stages.newInfluences: Hermes/Thoth and mystery guidance in Steiner’s description
stages.beings: Hermes-linked mystery teachers; hierarchies; inherited opposing influences
stages.people: Temple, star, death and afterlife symbolism
stages.events: Development of Egypto-Chaldean mystery culture
stages.contribution: Mediates spiritual-cosmic ideas through outer signs and law
stages.risk: Possible fixation on external symbols or destiny
stages.note: A post-Atlantean cultural period in Steiner's account.

stages.name: Greco–Roman
stages.inheritedForces: Egypto-Chaldean sentient soul and symbolic science
stages.activeForces: Intellectual/mind soul; individualized conceptual life and cultural form
stages.inheritedAbilities: Thinking, inherited mystery wisdom, outer perception
stages.newAbilities: Philosophy, art, personal civic life, Roman law
stages.increasing: Personality, conceptual articulation, physical expression of spiritual ideas
stages.decreasing: Instinctive spiritual perception
stages.newInfluences: Christ incarnates and Mystery of Golgotha occurs during this age
stages.beings: Christ; mystery initiates; spiritual hierarchies; persistent Lucifer/Ahriman
stages.people: Greek artistic form, Roman civic/legal consciousness
stages.events: Mystery of Golgotha (first century CE)
stages.contribution: Christ impulse enters Earth development; stronger individual “I”
stages.risk: Formalism, outer power and loss of inward spiritual vision
stages.note: A post-Atlantean cultural period in Steiner's account.

stages.name: Modern consciousness-soul age (present)
stages.inheritedForces: Greco–Roman personal judgment, Christ impulse and inherited thought
stages.activeForces: Consciousness soul; self-reliance, empirical inquiry and moral individuality
stages.inheritedAbilities: Intellectual thought, science, religion, law, spiritual-cultural inheritance
stages.newAbilities: Self-aware truth-seeking and freedom; possibility of consciously trained spiritual perception
stages.decreasing: Inherited natural clairvoyance and direct spiritual certainty
stages.newInfluences: No new exclusivity: ongoing Christ impulse; continuing Luciferic and Ahrimanic temptations
stages.beings: Christ impulse; Lucifer and Ahriman; spiritual beings remain active
stages.people: Scientific, individualizing, often material-oriented consciousness
stages.events: Modern cultural epoch begins c. 1413; present in 2026
stages.contribution: Freely transform thought into moral insight and spiritual cognition
stages.risk: Materialism, isolated egoism, technocratic domination; untested passion
stages.note: A post-Atlantean cultural period in Steiner's account.

stages.name: Future sixth cultural age
stages.inheritedForces: Consciousness-soul autonomy and living Christ impulse
stages.activeForces: Spirit-Self impulse and renewed ethical spiritual perception; social warmth
stages.inheritedAbilities: Critical thinking, independent moral agency
stages.newAbilities: Projected cooperation and consciously earned spiritual insight; love motif
stages.increasing: Spirit-Self receptivity, social understanding and love
stages.decreasing: Isolated intellect and antisocial alienation (goal, not guaranteed fact)
stages.newInfluences: Christ impulse pictured as working through spiritual seeing
stages.beings: Christ / Spirit-Self; ongoing adversarial powers in Steiner’s narrative
stages.people: Projected brotherhood and clairvoyant-spiritual orientation
stages.events: Transition to sixth cultural period (future; not observed)
stages.contribution: Synthesizes freedom with spiritual connectedness
stages.risk: Risk of false collectivism or pseudo-spiritual authority
stages.note: Steiner's prospective description, not an observed historical period.

stages.name: Future seventh cultural age
stages.inheritedForces: Sixth period social-spiritual capacities; increasing Spirit-Self orientation
stages.activeForces: Prophetic / hope motif in Steiner’s eschatological account
stages.inheritedAbilities: Self-conscious thought and increasingly spiritualized social faculties
stages.newAbilities: Projected preparation for next great Earth epoch; details not fully specified
stages.decreasing: Current form of post-Atlantean life eventually passes
stages.newInfluences: Christ impulse described with prophetic emphasis; no precise new incoming beings established
stages.beings: Christ impulse and continuing hierarchies; no exclusive stage catalogue
stages.people: Not a describable contemporary society; Steiner’s future picture remains schematic
stages.events: Future culmination and transition; catastrophe in some lectures
stages.contribution: Prepares movement beyond post-Atlantean development
stages.risk: Speculative details and apocalyptic conflict cannot be dated as history
stages.note: Steiner's prospective description, not an observed historical period.

oracles.name: Sun / Christ
oracles.focus: Central directing oracle; initiation focused on Sun Being/Christ mystery; synthesizing role

oracles.name: Saturn
oracles.focus: Particular lineage of initiates oriented toward Saturn-related higher beings

oracles.name: Jupiter
oracles.focus: Particular lineage of initiates oriented toward Jupiter-related higher beings

oracles.name: Mars
oracles.focus: Particular lineage of initiates oriented toward Mars-related higher beings

oracles.name: Venus
oracles.focus: Initiation under Venus-related spiritual guide; more individual thought-formation

oracles.name: Mercury
oracles.focus: Initiation under Mercury-related spiritual guide; supersensible knowledge

oracles.name: Vulcan
oracles.focus: Earthward focus, foundations of later science and art
